title: Golden milk (haldi doodh)
summary: Warm almond and coconut milk whisked with turmeric, ginger, cinnamon and black pepper; soothing and mildly sweet.

ingredients.note: or a few slices of fresh ginger

steps: Whisk the almond milk, turmeric and coconut milk in a small pan with the ginger, cinnamon, cardamom and black pepper.
Warm over medium-low heat, whisking often, until it steams and small bubbles appear at the edge. Simmer gently 3–4 minutes; do not let it boil over.
Whisk in the erythritol until dissolved.
Strain if you used fresh ginger, then pour into mugs and serve hot.
tips: Traditionally it is made with cow's milk; this version is dairy-free as written, and the coconut milk gives it body.
Turmeric stains; rinse the pan and whisk straight away.

origin.history: Haldi doodh, milk boiled with turmeric, is a long-standing home remedy across the Indian subcontinent, given especially at bedtime or for colds. Turmeric has been used in South Asian cooking and traditional medicine for a very long time. The English name golden milk and the drink's popularity in Western cafés date only from the 2010s.
